input.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
input.rationale: No exclusivity, sole-source, or requirements obligation is imposed on Bluefly anywhere in the Agreement. Searches for "exclusive", sole-supplier, requirements-purchase, minimum-volume and no-other-provider language returned only the warranty disclaimer (§ 5.2), tax-exclusive charges (§ 4.3) and nonexclusive licence grants in IBM's favour — none of which restrict our sourcing. Affirmatively, § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) confirms each party may enter into similar agreements with others, and the charges/services provisions (§§ 4.1, 11.5, 13.1) contain no commitment to source from IBM. This meets the preferred position that Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation, so no redline is proposed.
